subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from Chicago to New York on June 15th. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 10:00 AM from O'Hare International Airport. Please arrive at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
